items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Warren Bennett was playing Town of the Lake Swan. He's over there too.

ctx.x: I'm going to see him Sunday if I can. Where? Over the Lake? Over the Lake Harrow and I'm supposed to drive over there. Oh yeah?
I won't be telling him if you saw me. I'll write it down. Yes, he's a boy so friend that I am. I haven't played it to. And Warren Bennett was playing Town of the Lake Swan. He's over there too.
Yes, I'm just saying. You know all those times? No, but Harold tells me about him. He's going to, uh, he's going to introduce me to them all. Oh, I understand. Oh, who is it Harold?
